title: Implement CAPABILITIES, MODE READER, and QUIT
description:
Implement CAPABILITIES: return list based on what is enabled (VERSION 2, READER, POST, IHAVE, OVER, HDR, LIST ACTIVE etc, STARTTLS if TLS configured, AUTHINFO if auth configured). Implement MODE READER: return 200. Implement QUIT: send 205 and close. Artifact: reader/src/session/commands/capabilities.rs.

Acceptance:
- CAPABILITIES response lists only capabilities that are actually available
- slrn connects and completes MODE READER exchange without error
- QUIT causes clean TCP close (FIN) not RST
